mapper.sql: a.org01_code_id AS code_id, b.org02_info_id AS info_id, b.org02_parent_code_id AS parent_code_id, a.org01_org_cd AS org_cd, b.org02_kor_nm AS kor_nm, b.org02_eng_nm AS eng_nm, b.org02_level_cd AS level_cd, f_cdnm('OrgLevelCode', b.org02_level_cd, a.org01_company_id, b.org02_mod_date) AS level_nm, b.org02_sort_order AS sort_order, b.org02_mod_date::date AS mod_date, b.org02_mod_reason AS mod_reason, a.org01_open_date::date AS open_date, a.org01_open_reason AS open_reason, a.org01_close_date::date AS close_date, a.org01_close_reason AS close_reason, b.org02_note AS note
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE org_tree_down(org01_company_id, org02_code_id, org02_parent_code_id, depth, path, cycle) AS ( SELECT a.org01_company_id , b.org02_code_id , b.org02_parent_code_id , 1 , ARRAY[coalesce(b.org02_sort_order,'0')||b.org02_kor_nm::text] , false FROM org01_code a INNER JOIN org02_info b ON org01_code_id = org02_code_id WHERE 1=1 AND org01_company_id = #{companyId} AND b.org02_parent_code_id = 0 AND f_trunc(#{baseDate}::date) BETWEEN f_trunc(org01_open_date) AND coalesce(org01_close_date, to_date('99991231', 'yyyymmdd')) AND org02_mod_date = ( SELECT max(x.org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info x WHERE x.org02_code_id = b.org02_code_id AND f_trunc(x.org02_mod_date) <= f_trunc(#{baseDate}::date) ) UNION ALL SELECT a.org01_company_id , b.org02_code_id , b.org02_parent_code_id , c.depth + 1 , array_append(c.path, coalesce(b.org02_sort_order,'0')::text||b.org02_kor_nm::text) , coalesce(b.org02_sort_order,'0')||b.org02_kor_nm = any(c.path) FROM org01_code a INNER JOIN org02_info b ON a.org01_code_id = b.org02_code_id INNER JOIN org_tree_down c ON b.org02_parent_code_id = c.org02_code_id WHERE 1=1 AND a.org01_company_id = #{companyId} AND f_trunc(#{baseDate}::date) BETWEEN f_trunc(org01_open_date) AND coalesce(org01_close_date, to_date('99991231', 'yyyymmdd')) AND org02_mod_date = ( SELECT max(x.org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info x WHERE x.org02_code_id = b.org02_code_id AND f_trunc(x.org02_mod_date) <= f_trunc(#{baseDate}::date) ) AND NOT cycle ) SELECT , c.depth - 1 AS level, ( WITH emp00 AS (SELECT * FROM getPerson(#{companyId}, #{baseDate}::date)) SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(f_emp_kor_nm(emp03_person_id)),', ') FROM emp00 x INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON x.emp00_trans_id = emp03_trans_id WHERE a.org01_code_id = x.emp00_org_code_id AND COALESCE(emp03_org_head_yn, 'false') LIKE 'true' AND emp03_trans_cd != '900' /*(900:퇴직)*/ AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp04_add_title WHERE emp04_add_person_id = emp00_person_id AND ( emp04_start_date > #{baseDate}::date OR COALESCE(emp04_close_date,'9999-12-31') < #{baseDate}::date ) ) ) AS org_head_list FROM org01_code a INNER JOIN org02_info b ON org01_code_id = org02_code_id INNER JOIN org_tree_down c ON b.org02_code_id = c.org02_code_id WHERE f_trunc(#{baseDate}::date) BETWEEN f_trunc(a.org01_open_date) AND COALESCE(a.org01_close_date, to_date('99991231', 'yyyymmdd')) AND b.org02_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info x WHERE x.org02_code_id = b.org02_code_id AND f_trunc(x.org02_mod_date) <= f_trunc(#{baseDate}::date) ) ORDER BY c.path

SELECT , 0 AS level, NULL AS org_head_list FROM org01_code a , org02_info b WHERE a.org01_code_id = #{codeId} AND #{baseDate}::date BETWEEN a.org01_open_date AND COALESCE(a.org01_close_date, to_date('99991231','yyyymmdd')) AND b.org02_code_id = a.org01_code_id AND b.org02_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info x WHERE x.org02_code_id = a.org01_code_id AND x.org02_mod_date <= #{baseDate}::date )
SELECT org01_company_id FROM org01_code WHERE org01_code_id = #{codeId}

SELECT org02_info_id AS info_id, org02_code_id AS code_id, org02_parent_code_id AS parent_code_id, org02_mod_date::date AS mod_date, org02_mod_reason AS mod_reason, org02_kor_nm AS kor_nm, org02_eng_nm AS eng_nm, org02_level_cd AS level_cd, NULL AS level_nm, org02_sort_order AS sort_order, org02_note AS note FROM org02_info a , org01_code b WHERE org02_info_id = #{infoId} AND org01_code_id = org02_code_id
SELECT count(*) FROM org02_info WHERE org02_code_id = #{codeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO org01_code (org01_code_id, org01_company_id, org01_org_cd, org01_open_date, org01_close_date, org01_open_reason, org01_close_reason, org01_note) VALUES (#{orgCodeId}, #{companyId}, #{orgCd}, #{openDate}, #{closeDate}, #{openReason}, #{closeReason}, #{note})

INSERT INTO org02_info (org02_info_id, org02_kor_nm, org02_mod_date, org02_mod_reason, org02_code_id, org02_parent_code_id, org02_eng_nm, org02_note, org02_level_cd, org02_sort_order, org02_mod_detail) VALUES (#{orgInfoId}, #{korNm}, #{modDate}, #{modReason}, #{orgCodeId}, #{parentCodeId}, #{engNm}, #{note}, #{levelCd}, #{sortOrder}, #{modDetail})
mapper.update: UPDATE org02_info SET org02_kor_nm = #{korNm}, org02_mod_date = #{modDate}, org02_mod_reason = #{modReason}, org02_parent_code_id = #{parentCodeId}, org02_eng_nm = #{engNm}, org02_note = #{note}, org02_level_cd = #{levelCd}, org02_sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE org02_info_id = #{orgInfoId}
